summary.en: A Turkmenistan gas pipeline is nearing an Afghan city, raising strategic concerns for the region. A war widow in Pakistan described her forced involvement in a conflict she calls a club nobody wants to join. Afghan migrants dying at the Iran-Türkiye border increased the humanitarian toll linked to the broader instability. The conflict still accounts for 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: En gassrørledning fra Turkmenistan nærmer seg en afghansk by, og vekker strategiske bekymringer for regionen. En krigsepke i Pakistan beskrev sin tvungne deltakelse i en konflikt hun kaller en klubb ingen vil bli med i. Afghanske migranter som dør ved grensen mellom Iran og Tyrkia øker den humanitære kostnaden knyttet til den bredere ustabiliteten. Konflikten står fortsatt for 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
